info.title: Admission Hub API
info.description: Multi-tenant partner admissions CRM backend (Express + Prisma). Access JWTs are short-lived; use POST /api/v1/auth/refresh to rotate opaque refresh tokens. Most routes require Bearer auth and enforce role + tenant scope in services.

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token (store securely; rotated on /auth/refresh)
